notes: Raid points from the wiki's Raid points page: wealth points and points per colonist by storyteller wealth, Strive to survive (threat scale 1), the starting factor 0.7 to day 10 and 1 from day 40 (straight line between: unverified), adaptation from the wiki: AdaptDays start at 0 (factor 0.8), cannot pass 0 in the first 30 days, grow every 12 hours by the step list (the wiki's table halved; whether its numbers are per check or per day is unclear, we took per day), fall by 30 (6 to 11 colonists) when a colonist dies and by 8 to 3.5 when one goes down, stay between -60 and 100; the factor curve is blended with 1 by the difficulty's adaptationImpact and grows by its adaptationGrowth. fleeLostFraction and the give-up time (RimWorld's 26,000 to 38,000 ticks) are recalled from RimWorld's assault plan.
